# iOS Headers - LLM Access Guide

Site: https://headers.82flex.com/
Purpose: Explore iOS SDK header files across versions.
Primary language: English (UI and content).

## Canonical Entry Points
- Home / search: /?q=<query>
- Directory listing: /tree/<directory_name>
- File view: /view/<version_id>/<absolute_path>
- File view (latest): /view/latest/<absolute_path>
- Source text: /raw/<version_id>/<absolute_path>

## URL Parameter Rules
- Query parameters are sanitized server-side.
- Allowed characters: 0-9 A-Z a-z space(%20) / . _ -
- Unsupported characters are removed before processing.
- Relevant query params:
  - q
  - dir
  - cursor
  - direction
  - format

## Search Scope (Important)
Search supports:
- Directory names
- Framework names
- Objective-C header file names

Search does NOT support:
- property names
- ivar names
- method names
- symbol-level full-text code search

## Recommended Retrieval Strategy
1. If you know the exact file path, prefer:
   - /view/latest/<absolute_path>
2. If not, locate the directory first:
   - /tree/<directory_name>
3. Then open a specific versioned file:
   - /view/<version_id>/<absolute_path>
4. Only use /raw when plain text output is required.

## Directory Name Format
- directory_name normally uses the last 2 path segments: parent_dir/dir_name
- versioned framework paths normalize Foo.framework/Versions/A/Foo to Foo.framework/Foo
- Examples:
  - CFNetwork.framework/CFNetwork
  - Foundation.framework/Foundation
  - IOKit.framework/IOKit
  - libexec/backboardd

## Practical Examples
- /?q=UIView
- /tree/CFNetwork.framework/CFNetwork
- /view/17.0_21A329/System/Library/Frameworks/UIKit.framework/Headers/UIView.h
- /raw/17.0_21A329/System/Library/Frameworks/UIKit.framework/Headers/UIView.h

## Freshness Notes
- The page shows an "Indexed snapshot" version label on result pages.
- Use that snapshot label when describing recency in summaries.

## Citation Guidance
- Prefer citing canonical view URLs:
  - /view/<version_id>/<absolute_path>
- Avoid citing diff pages as primary references.
